Products_Recommendation: Products Recommendation               Test Rigs for Hydraulic Components A large number of our prefabricated test rigs for hydraulic components are used to test valves of every kind: servo valve, valve functional, valve dynamic, direction valve and camshaft timer test rigs, a rig for filling and testing gas pressure valves, and a pressure fatigue test rig on which hydraulic components are cyclically tested according to DIN EN ISO 8434. Our realized test rigs work with energy recovery and therefore have a particularly low power consumption.               Automation & EtherLab® Real-Time Toolkit We automate individual devices or test rigs as well as entire facilities. Customers receive the complete software of their projects in source code, with all data exchange formats documented - our commitment to investment protection. We frequently use EtherCAT, a field bus standard developed by Beckhoff, alongside EtherLab, an open-source project of IgH: an open source toolkit for real-time code generation under Linux with optional integration of MATLAB/Simulink and EtherCAT technology.                 Load Test Rigs On these test rigs, test items are loaded according to defined criteria. The load takes place by applying deformations, forces or layers, and can be constant over time or follow specific load curves. Realized rigs include the slat flap test rig, coupling test rig, breaker test rig, screw connection test rig, end-of-line function test rig, swivel test rig and sealing test bench.               Force-Direction Measurement Systems Force-direction measurement systems create force-direction diagrams of electromechanical actuators or spring elements. Force between test item and rig is measured together with the position of the force measuring point, plus direction, current and clamping voltage, so hysteresis behaviour and different control concepts can be investigated. A swivel unit simulates a changed installation position. Measurement path 430 mm, 0.01-20 mm/s, swivel 0-180, axial force to 800 N, direction to 5 um.

The modular design enables flexible configurations of ratios, torque capacities, input and output arrangements, and mounting positions.

With high load capacity, efficient power transmission and robust construction, the series is designed for reliable long-term operation. Application-specific selection is available according to load characteristics, operating hours and environmental conditions. Typical applications include mining, metallurgy, cement, material handling, cranes, energy and heavy industrial equipment.               Planetary Gearbox TANHON Planetary Gearboxes combine high torque capacity with compact dimensions and high power density. The planetary transmission structure distributes loads across multiple gears, providing efficient and stable power transmission for demanding applications.

Modular configurations are available for different ratios, stages, input and output arrangements, and mounting requirements. Application-specific solutions can also be engineered according to operating loads and duty conditions. Typical applications include mining, construction machinery, cranes, material handling, metallurgy, energy and heavy industrial equipment.                 Modular Helical Gearmotor TANHON Modular Helical Geared Motors combine efficient helical gearing with a flexible modular platform for a wide range of industrial drive applications. Different motor powers, ratios, output speeds and mounting arrangements can be configured to match specific equipment requirements.

Designed for high efficiency, smooth operation, low noise and compact installation, the series is suitable for conveyors, packaging machinery, logistics systems, environmental equipment, automation and general industrial machinery. TANHON's online selection platform further simplifies product selection and technical configuration.               Customized Gearbox TANHON Custom-Engineered Industrial Gearboxes are developed for applications where standard products cannot fully meet specific operating requirements. Each solution can be engineered around load characteristics, installation space, interfaces, operating environment and duty conditions.

For high-power, high-torque, continuous-duty and shock-load applications, TANHON can optimize gearing, housing, shafts, bearings, lubrication and cooling systems as an integrated transmission solution. Products_Recommendation: Products Recommendation               FLOODING SEAL FLOODING sealing is an advanced sealing technology widely used in various industrial fields, such as petroleum, chemical, power, pharmaceuticals, etc. It is a composite material composed of metal and plastic, characterized by high strength, high rigidity, and high corrosion resistance. The working principle of the universal seal mainly relies on its unique structural design, which tightly combines metal and plastic through pre compression to form a complete seal. During operation, fluid enters the sealing chamber through the inlet of the flood seal, exerting pressure on metal and plastic. Due to their different characteristics, metal and plastic undergo different deformations when subjected to pressure, forming an extremely thin sealing film to prevent fluid leakage. This sealing technology can maintain stable sealing performance in harsh environments such as high temperature, high pressure, and corrosion, and is therefore widely used in various industrial fields. ‌               V-shaped composite seals V-shaped composite seals are usually composed of components such as sealing bodies, pressure covers, and elastic elements. The sealing body is the main part of the sealing component, and its V-shaped structure enables it to generate radial and axial sealing forces under pressure. The gland is used to fix the sealing body, ensuring that it will not fall off or move during operation. Elastic components play a role in compensating for sealing gaps, buffering vibrations, and improving sealing performance.                 JF DUST SEAL RING Polyurethane rubber dust sealing ring               BUILT-UP PISTON SEAL The combination piston sealing ring is composed of three different materials (PU \ NBR \ POM), and the sealing surface is made of high hardness and wear-resistant polyurethane material. It adopts a structure of two grooves and three seals to ensure sufficient lubrication. The bottom rubber body provides a certain pressure to the sealing surface and compensates for wear. The POM retaining ring can reduce the gap between the cylinder and the piston, prevent the sealing body from being squeezed out, and also play a role in high-pressure guidance

Products_Recommendation:
Products Recommendation               HY(F)1 Series Double‑Nozzle Flapper Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Valve The electro‑hydraulic servo valve is a critical control component in hydraulic servo systems. Our HY(F)1 Series Double‑Nozzle‑Flapper Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Valves feature a general flow range from 1.5 L/min to 400 L/min and are commonly used in position control systems. Special‑purpose valves can be customized according to user requirements for special port opening, special overlap, special linear gain, and special spool position under zero control signal, etc. Customization is also available for diverse operating scenarios, including special working media such as blue oil and fuel oil, high‑contamination‑level oil, high‑temperature oil, as well as stringent vibration and acceleration requirements.               HY(F)2 Series Direct‑Drive Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Valve (Proportional Servo Valve) The HY(F)2 Series Direct‑Drive Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Valve (Proportional Servo Valve) covers a flow range of 4 L/min to 100 L/min. It delivers higher control accuracy than conventional proportional valves, with a response speed between that of ordinary proportional valves and high‑end double‑nozzle‑flapper servo valves. It has less stringent requirements for oil cleanliness compared with double‑nozzle‑flapper servo valves, lowering system maintenance costs. Widely applied in test loading platforms, construction machinery, metallurgical equipment, aeronautical ground simulation facilities, robots, plastic machinery and other scenarios, it balances control performance and on‑site reliability.                 HY(G) Series Servo Cylinder, HY(Z) Series Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Actuator The HY(G) Series Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Cylinders include linear cylinders and rotary actuators. Featuring low friction, stick‑slip‑free performance and high frequency response, the products also possess characteristics of high pressure resistance, high temperature resistance, high‑speed capability, long service life and zero leakage.
The HY(Z) Series Electro‑Hydraulic Servo Actuators are mainly composed of electro‑hydraulic servo valves, linear servo cylinders or rotary servo motors, sensors and accessories.               HY(F) Series Electro‑Hydraulic Brake Control Valve The electro‑hydraulic brake control valve serves as the core pressure‑control actuator of the aircraft fly‑by‑wire anti‑skid brake system. It receives electrical control signals from the brake controller, converts the electrical signals into hydraulic pressure output, and drives brake actuators to generate braking torque for wheel braking and anti‑skid protection. It is widely applied to the landing‑gear brake systems of military aircraft, civil aircraft, UAVs and eVTOLs.
Featuring fast pressure response and high tracking accuracy, the product meets high‑frequency dynamic adjustment requirements for anti‑skid functions. With closed‑loop pressure output, it resists supply‑pressure fluctuations. It supports dual‑redundancy electrical interfaces to satisfy high‑reliability requirements for aviation applications. Capable of withstanding wide temperature ranges as well as vibration and shock, it adapts to the harsh mounting environment of landing gears.

The fastening power of taper lock bushings has to do with their flanged, split design with a tapered diameter. This design ensures a firm connection with the shaft by providing a tight fit with radial pressure. It also offers simpler installation and removal procedures without keys or set screws. Among other benefits of taper-lock bushings are high-torque capacity, impact dampening, and the ability to accommodate small tolerances in the mounted part and shaft sizes. data_1: Suzhou Zorr Bearing Co., Ltd. manufactures high-precision bearings and accessories. Products_Recommendation:
Products Recommendation               Cylindrical roller bearings Cylindrical roller bearings are rolling bearings composed of inner rings, outer rings, rollers, and guiding elements. The rollers make line contact with the raceways, resulting in uniform stress distribution, high radial load-carrying capacity, good impact resistance, and high speed adaptability. They are widely used in high-load applications such as gearboxes, metallurgical equipment, and port machinery.
ZORR manufactures the following cylindrical roller bearings: cage-guided cylindrical roller bearings, full-complement cylindrical roller bearings, and high-precision or custom-engineered bearings for special operating conditions.               Angular contact ball bearings Angular contact ball bearings are designed to withstand combined radial and axial loads, with contact angles of 15 °, 25 °, 40 °, and other series. They combine high speed and high rigidity, enabling them to achieve lightweight and high precision in limited spaces. They are widely used in precision machine tool spindles, water pumps, air compressors, and other applications.
ZORR offers standard series, high-speed series, and paired combination series.                 Deep groove ball bearings Deep groove ball bearings are renowned for their compact structure, low friction coefficient, and high limiting speed, featuring low noise, low vibration, high precision, and smooth operation with excellent adaptability and reliability. They are capable of withstanding both radial loads and bidirectional axial loads, meeting the requirements of high-speed, light-load, low-noise, and other working conditions, and are widely used in motors, automobiles, household appliances, agricultural machinery, general-purpose machinery, and other industries.
ZORR's deep groove ball bearing range includes: Standard Type, Shielded Type, Contact-Seal Maintenance-Free Type, Low-Noise High-Speed Type, and Customized Products for Special Working Conditions.               Tapered roller bearings Tapered roller bearings consist of an inner ring, an outer ring, tapered rollers and a cage. The rollers contact the raceways in a line contact, enabling the bearings to withstand both large radial loads and one-direction axial loads simultaneously, with high
load-carrying capacity and rigidity. Preload can be precisely controlled by adjusting the axial clearance. They are widely used in industries such as   automotive wheel hubs, gear reducers, steel rolling equipment, mining machinery and machine tool spindles.
The main types of tapered roller bearings produced by ZORR include single-row, double-row and four-row tapered roller bearings, as well as metric and inch series, to meet the selection requirements of different loads and working conditions.

Products_Recommendation: Products Recommendation               O‑ring seal e purpose of using O-ring seals is to prevent the leakage and loss of liquids or gases (commonly referred to as media). Due to their simple and convenient installation and minimal required mounting space, O-rings are the most commonly used type of seal. Provided that the groove design and material selection are appropriate, and the operating conditions fall within the temperature range of the rubber material, O-rings can provide long-term sealing effectiveness in both static and dynamic sealing applications.               Hydraulic seal Hydraulic seals are applied in various hydraulic systems, including Y‑rings, O‑rings, step seals, dust seals and other series. They provide dynamic sealing for pistons and piston rods as well as static sealing for end caps. With high‑pressure resistance, wear resistance and oil resistance, and available in a variety of materials, they effectively prevent hydraulic oil leakage and maintain system pressure. Widely compatible with hydraulic cylinders, construction machinery, injection molding machines and other hydraulic equipment.                 Pneumatic Seals Pneumatic seals are suitable for various pneumatic systems, including O‑rings, Y‑rings, dust seals and other series. They realize dynamic sealing for pistons and piston rods as well as static sealing for end caps. Available in NBR, EPDM, PU and other materials with low friction and good wear resistance. They prevent compressed‑air leakage and stabilize air pressure, widely used in air cylinders, solenoid valves, automatic production lines and other pneumatic equipment. Complete specifications and custom service available.               Electromagnetic valve seal Solenoid valve seals are suitable for various fluid solenoid valves, including O‑rings, diaphragms, valve seat gaskets and spool seals. Available in NBR, EPDM, FKM, PU materials with good resilience and medium resistance. Adapt to high‑frequency opening‑closing of spools to prevent internal and external leakage and ensure sensitive valve operation. Widely used in pneumatic solenoid valves, water valves, pulse dust‑removal valves and other fluid control equipment. Complete specifications and custom service available.

GEKA Claw Couplings K&G GEKA Claw Couplings are symmetrical quick couplings for water, compressed air, agricultural irrigation, gardening and general industrial hose systems. The range includes male- and female-threaded ends, hose tails, blank caps, adjusting-ring versions, Y pieces and spray nozzles, mainly in brass. The claw connection enables fast assembly within the matching system. Size, seal and working pressure must be confirmed for the selected model and application.                 Tankwagen Couplings (TW Couplings) K&G Tankwagen (TW) Couplings are designed for tanker and industrial fluid-transfer connections. EN 14420-6 / DIN 28450 interface variants include MK female-threaded clamping rings, VK female-threaded adapters, MB caps, VB plugs and MKS hose-shank couplings, with brass, aluminum and stainless-steel options. They suit loading and unloading applications in petrochemical, fuel and general industry. Material, seal, size and media compatibility should be confirmed for each model.               Hose Fittings & Clamps K&G Hose Fittings & Clamps are used to connect, repair and secure industrial hoses. The range includes KC nipples, hose menders, universal claw couplings, and German, American, British, double-bolt, wire, spiral and DIN 2817 safety clamp options. Clamp materials include zinc-plated steel and stainless steel, with multiple band widths and clamping ranges for industrial hose, agricultural, compressed-air and general fluid-transfer applications. Selection should be based on hose outside diameter, material, working pressure and medium.

Products Recommendation               High-strength ring belt Flat belts are widely used for power transmission and corresponding light- and heavy-duty conveying across various industries. They perform particularly well in machinery for the textile, printing, packaging, woodworking, and tobacco sectors, such as automatic box-gluing machines, offset printing presses, multi-drill machines, wood-turning lathes, ventilation cabinets, and crushers.
Key features of the high-strength ring belt: oil-resistant and dust-proof, energy-saving and noise-reducing, suitable for harsh environments, with high elasticity and long service life.               Rough-surface eraser Rough-surfaced rubber is used to increase the friction coefficient and is commonly employed in fabric traction across various processes in the textile industry. It is applied on guide rollers of various types of non-jet looms, such as air-jet, water-jet, rapier, and shuttleless looms, as well as on inspection machines, printing and dyeing equipment, and plastic circular machines. The standard product of rough-surfaced rubber has a length of 100 meters, a width of 100 mm, and comes in rolls with widths of 50 mm, 40 mm, and 38 mm. Other widths can be supplied according to requirements. When in use, it is spirally wrapped around the roller and secured with an adhesive.
Characteristics of Rough-Surfaced Rubber: Wear-resistant, non-deformable, non-elastic, strong and durable.                 High-speed dragon belt The high-speed dragon belt is particularly well-suited for high-speed transmission applications in the textile industry, including blowers, air-jet spinning machines, carding machines, double-twisting machines, elastic yarn machines, covered yarn machines, ultra-long ring spinning machines, decorative twisting machines, and large circular knitting machines, where it has demonstrated excellent performance.
High-speed dragon belt features: high efficiency with low elongation, high flexibility and fatigue resistance, excellent anti-static performance, and stable friction coefficient.               Box pasting machine belt The glue-applying machine belt is a nylon-based flat belt and serves as the core conveying component for fully automatic color box gluing machines. As shown in the image, this yellow-green double-sided rubber flat belt is widely used in the printing and packaging industry for paper feeding, folding, and pressing stations in gluing equipment.

Products_Recommendation:
Products Recommendation               Splined Flange The circular internal‑splined connecting flange is a critical component for power transmission in drive systems. It is widely used at the input or output ends of axles and gearboxes for construction machinery, mining machinery, agricultural machinery and other equipment. This product series features nearly a hundred specifications with excellent universality and interchangeability. Our company can supply internal splines of various specifications upon customer requirements to meet the supporting demands of different OEMs.               Wing style flange The special‑shaped (C‑type) internal‑splined face‑keyway connecting flange is specially designed for high‑torque and high‑load working conditions. Adopting a unique C‑type internal spline and face keyway structure, it is suitable for input or output connections of transmission systems for heavy‑duty axles, gearboxes, mining trucks and agricultural machinery. The product can be manufactured by integral forging or milling according to customer requirements to satisfy demands for different strength grades and service environments.                 Cross Serrated Flange The face‑tooth connecting flange adopts a face‑tooth structure instead of conventional key connections. It is mainly used for connecting transmission systems with drive shafts in loaders, new‑energy electric loaders, transfer cases, power take‑offs and other equipment. The face‑tooth design can effectively distribute impact loads and reduce the risk of bolt shear, making it particularly suitable for harsh working conditions with frequent start‑stop operations and heavy‑duty impacts. The product is compatible with heavy‑duty equipment and meets high‑reliability requirements.               Planetary gear pin As a core component of the planetary gear train, the planetary wheel shaft plays a vital role in supporting and power transmission, and is widely used in various mechanical equipment.
Our company is equipped with automatic production lines for planetary wheel shafts and pin shafts. The product range includes axle‑end planetary wheel shafts, gearbox planetary shafts, reducer gear shafts, and various types of pin shafts, which are extensively applied in construction machinery, mining trucks, agricultural machinery, industrial reducers and other fields.
Relying on automatic processing units and centerless grinding units, high‑efficiency and high‑precision production is realized to meet mass supporting requirements.

Applied in hydraulic systems, they are used for pressure measurement at various test points and as pipelines for fluid-medium transmission. Matching with pressure-test point connectors, these hose assemblies adopt advanced structure with reliable sealing and firm crimping. They are compact, lightweight and easy to operate. Connection types include hinged joint, quick-connect and cone-seal styles. Customization is available.               Pressure‑test Fitting Pressure‑test fitting is a special detecting port for hydraulic systems with a built‑in self‑sealing poppet valve. It is permanently installed on valve blocks, pipelines, oil cylinders and hydraulic components. The poppet valve closes automatically upon disconnection to avoid medium leakage. When connected with pressure‑test hose assembly, the valve opens to realize on‑line pressure measurement, oil sampling and system venting without equipment shutdown.

Featuring compact structure, reliable sealing, simple operation and stable performance under high‑pressure working conditions, it is available in various thread specifications and compatible with HF series mini high‑pressure hose assemblies. Widely used in excavators, cranes, machine tools and other hydraulic equipment. Non‑standard customization is supported. The inner tube is made of thermoplastic polyester, with a single‑layer pressure‑resistant synthetic fiber reinforcement and polyurethane outer cover. Needling process is available. They can be made into twin hoses, multi‑row hoses and combined hoses of different sizes, with various color options.

Products_Recommendation: Products Recommendation               Cylindrical Roller Bearings Cylindrical rollers and raceways are linear contact bearings. Load capacity, mainly bear radial load. The friction between the rolling element and the retaining edge of the ring is small, suitable for high-speed rotation. According to whether the ring has ribs, it can be divided into single row cylindrical roller bearings such as NU, NJ, NUP, N, NF, and double row cylindrical roller bearings such as NNU and NN. The bearing has a separable structure with inner ring and outer ring.               Tapered Roller Bearings Tapered roller bearings are specially designed to withstand combined (radial and axial) loads. They have single-row, double-row and four-row tapered roller designs. Single row tapered roller bearings can bear radial load and axial load in only one direction. Under radial load, the axial component of the bearing will be affected and must be offset, so it is usually adjusted relative to the second bearing.                 Spherical Roller Bearings Spherical roller bearings have two rows of spherical rollers, the outer ring has a common concave spherical raceway, the inner ring has two concave raceways that are inclined at an angle to the bearing axis, the curvature center of the outer ring raceway is the same as the bearing center. Spherical roller bearings are self-aligning and are not affected by misalignment of the shaft and bearing box or deflection of the shaft, and can compensate for the resulting concentricity errors. In addition to bearing radial load, this type of bearing can also bear two-way axial load and its combined load. It has a large bearing capacity and good vibration and impact resistance.               Angular Contact Ball Bearings The raceways of the inner and outer rings of ACBB can have relative displacement in the direction of the horizontal axis, that can withstand combined loads—that is, radial and axial loads acting simultaneously. The axial-load carrying capacity of ACBB increases as the contact angle increases. The contact angle is defined as the angle between the line between the contact point of the steel ball and the raceway and the vertical line of the bearing axis on the radial plane. The load is transferred from one raceway to another along the line connecting the contact points of the steel ball and the raceway.

Products_Recommendation: Products Recommendation               PTFE bronze guide tape Bronze-filled PTFE guide tape combines the low friction and self-lubricating properties of PTFE with the wear resistance and load-bearing benefits of bronze filler. Designed to support and guide pistons and piston rods in hydraulic cylinders, it helps prevent direct metal-to-metal contact, reduce wear, and maintain smooth reciprocating movement. The composite offers good dimensional stability for hydraulic guiding applications. Supplied in rolls, the tape can be cut to the required installation length for convenient fitting and replacement. Different widths, thicknesses, and lengths are available to suit various cylinder sizes and application requirements.               Phenolic cloth guide tape Phenolic fabric guide tape is made from a fabric-reinforced phenolic resin composite, offering high load-bearing capacity and good wear resistance. Designed to support and guide pistons and piston rods in hydraulic cylinders, it carries radial loads, helps prevent direct metal-to-metal contact, reduces wear on sliding surfaces, and protects the sealing system. Its non-metallic composite structure is suitable for heavy-duty guiding applications and helps maintain stable piston and rod movement. Supplied in rolls, the tape can be cut to the required installation length, allowing convenient fitting and replacement for different cylinder sizes.                 KDAS compact piston seal KDAS is a compact, five-piece piston seal comprising one nitrile rubber sealing element, two backup rings, and two guide rings. It combines double-acting sealing, piston guidance, and extrusion protection in one assembly. The multi-lip sealing element provides reliable reciprocating sealing, good wear resistance, and low friction at low pressure. Backup rings help prevent seal extrusion, while guide rings support stable piston movement. Its compact design requires little axial space and allows convenient installation on both one-piece and split pistons. Suitable for double-acting hydraulic cylinders in construction machinery and industrial equipment.               Piston glyd ring The piston Glyd ring consists of a filled PTFE sealing ring and a rubber O-ring, providing bidirectional sealing for double-acting hydraulic cylinders. It offers good dynamic and static sealing performance with low friction, helping minimize stick-slip at low speeds and maintain smooth reciprocating motion. The simple groove design is suitable for one-piece pistons. It accommodates high and low pressures as well as high-frequency reciprocating applications. Nitrile rubber (NBR) or fluorocarbon rubber (FKM) O-rings can be selected, with material combinations tailored to the hydraulic medium and operating conditions.

Products Recommendation               YM04 The source code spring pressurized electromagnetic safety brake is a single disc brake with two friction surfaces. The shaft is connected to the spline sleeve through a flat key, and the spline sleeve is connected to the friction disc component through a spline.
When the stator is powered off, the force generated by the spring acts on the armature, tightly clamping the friction disc component driven by the shaft to rotate between the armature and the cover plate, thereby generating a braking torque. There will be a gap Z between the armature and the stator.
When the brake needs to be released, the stator is connected to direct current, and the generated magnetic field attracts the armature to move towards the stator, causing the armature to move.               YM08 Spring pressurized dry friction is preferred for emergency stop and start in places with high braking frequency.
Cleverly combining the rear cover of the motor with the stator of the brake, the motor and brake are integrated without changing the length and performance of the original motor. First choice for places with limited space.                 YM09 Micro motor brakes are suitable for electric vehicles, automatic doors, sliding doors, and other places. They are short, beautiful, sturdy, and durable.

Products_Recommendation: Products Recommendation               SAE flange SAE flanges are hydraulic flange fittings manufactured in accordance with the SAE J518 standard; the corresponding international standard is ISO 6162, whilst the German standards are the DIN 20066 / DIN 8902 series. They are primarily used to connect pipework and hose assemblies to valve blocks, pump stations and hydraulic cylinders in high-pressure hydraulic systems, and are one of the most widely used forms of high-pressure connection in industries such as construction machinery, shipping, metallurgy and wind power.               Pipe Fitting Pipe fittings (also known as tube fittings) are general-purpose connectors used to join pipes, pipe components, hoses and equipment interfaces. They are widely used in fields such as hydraulics, pneumatics, plumbing, petrochemicals, shipbuilding and construction machinery. Their core function is to ensure reliable connections and seals between pipes, whilst also offering resistance to pressure, temperature and corrosion, and facilitating easy disassembly, assembly and maintenance.                 Flare flange The SAE flared flange is a type of end connection within the SAE flange system. Unlike the common flat-face O-ring seal flanges (SAE J518 / ISO 6162), it achieves a seal through the contact of a conical surface (flared end), and is classified as a metal-to-metal or conical seal design. It is widely used in hydraulic, pneumatic, automotive and construction machinery piping systems.

Products Recommendation               OIL SEAL **Introduction to Oil Seal Products (English Version)**
 
An oil seal, also known as a shaft seal or rotary seal, is a critical mechanical component designed to prevent the leakage of lubricants (such as oil or grease) from machinery while keeping contaminants like dust, dirt, and moisture out. Typically installed between moving and stationary parts—especially in rotating equipment such as engines, gearboxes, pumps, and automotive drivetrains—oil seals ensure efficient operation, prolong equipment life, and maintain system integrity.
 
Most oil seals are constructed with three primary components:  
1. **Sealing Element (Lip):** Usually made of elastomeric materials like Nitrile Rubber (NBR), Fluorocarbon Rubber (FKM), or Silicone, the lip provides a tight contact with the shaft surface to block fluid escape.  
2. **Metal Reinforcement (Case):** A rigid metal outer ring gives structural support, facilitates installation, and ensures dimensional stability under pressure and temperature v

Products_Recommendation:
Products Recommendation               Permanent‑magnet gear reducer Luode’s fully self‑developed permanent‑magnet gear reducer delivers superior performance and high transmission efficiency with strong overload resistance. Suitable for various low‑speed, high‑torque industrial working conditions, it features reliable structure and stable output torque for power transmission applications across multiple industries.               洛德永磁蜗轮蜗杆RV/永磁准双曲面减速机 LUODE permanent magnet worm gear RV and permanent magnet hypoid reducers are matched with standalone permanent magnet synchronous motors. Featuring great compatibility, simple assembly and compact overall structure, they effectively save equipment installation space.
The RV worm gear model delivers large reduction ratio and reverse self-locking, running smoothly with low noise, ideal for heavy-load static holding applications. The hypoid reducer adopts hardened gear surface, with high transmission efficiency, low temperature rise, good wear resistance and longer service life.
Both models support multi-position mounting and hollow shaft output. Widely used in automatic equipment for ceramics, glass, food, woodworking and logistics, they serve as efficient and reliable reduction solutions for right-angle transmission conditions.                 LUODE R/K/S/F Gear Reducer LUODE R/K/S/F reducers are all compatible with permanent magnet synchronous motors. With a flange direct connection, they are easy to assemble, have a compact layout, and save installation space.

R series helical gear reducers offer high load capacity. K series helical-bevel reducers enable right-angle transmission. S series helical-worm reducers come with a self-locking function. F series parallel-shaft helical reducers adopt flat structure. All series use hardened gears with high efficiency, good wear resistance, and smooth, low-noise operation. Supporting multi-position mounting, they are widely used in automatic equipment for ceramics, glass, food, woodworking and logistics, delivering reliable reduction solutions for parallel and right-angle transmission applications.

Products Recommendation               Balanced Spiral Woven Conveyor Belts Balanced Weave Conveyor Belts are also known as spiral wire link conveyor belts, is the most commonly used belt for wire mesh conveyor belts.

Balanced Weave Conveyor Belt is a stainless steel balanced woven belt with left and right-hand wound spirals, connected by crimped cross wires. At the sides of the belt, the cross wire is welded to the spiral wire. Balanced weave belts can be used for a virtually infinite number of applications. Ranging from super strong for conveying heavy loads over large widths or conveying very hot products to very dense weaves for small products, unsorted goods or products requiring stable support.

PFM Screen’ Balanced Weave Conveyor Belts have been successfully used in the food industry, the heat treatment industry, the chemical industry and the glass industry, etc. Its simple design, the big range of dimensions (wire diameters and pitches) and the various ranges of belt materials are the main reason for its success.               人字形网带（复合编织输送带） Compound Weave Conveyor Belt, also named Stainless Steel Cordweave Conveyor Belt, Compound Balanced Woven Belt，V-shaped Conveyor Belt or Baking Band Conveyor Belt, have right-hand and left-hand spirals interconnecting by straight cross rods. 


The compound belt is a high-density, balanced spiral belt with multiple spirals and cross rods per pitch, resulting in minimal apertures and a flat surface. This structure ensures a close and flat mesh, ideal for conveying very small items. Its uniform heat transfer and smooth surface make it perfect for applications like biscuit baking and sorting small mechanical components. Popular for its durability and efficiency, the compound weave is a top choice in various industries, including food processing and precision manufacturing.                 Flexible Rod Conveyor Belts, Spiral Freezer Belt, Spiral Cooler Belt A Flexible Rod Belt is constructed from 3 components. 
1. Alternating spirals take care of the belt overlay. 
2. These spirals are connected to each other by means of smooth cross rods. 
3. Special chain links are mounted at the outer sides, which are locked by means of button heads. 

This kind of stainless steel wire mesh belt is especially designed for spiral or round conveyor as well as straight-running conveyor. With the ability to side flex, the belt can also be used for conveyors arranged to go around obstacles.The flexible rod belt is popular in the food industries, including cooling, cooking or freezing products.

Rod and spiral alternating coils structure efficiently improve production and reduce downtime. Owing for robust construction, this rod conveyor belting need far less maintenance. Besides, Flexible Rod belts can also be supplied with a link in the centre of the belt width to decrease its turning radii, as well as side guards to prevent product spillage.               Flat Flex Conveyor Belts Flat Flex Conveyor Belts also known as Rod Network Conveyor Belts, or Enrober conveyor belts, are distinguished by their unique construction and versatile applications. These belts are constructed from a series of looped wires that interlock with one another, creating a flexible and robust mesh. The simple structure makes it economical and lightweight. It can help to save costs and reduce downtime.

Custom dimensions can also be accommodated to meet specific requirements.

Products_Recommendation:
Products Recommendation               COLIBRI Perfect finish for sophisticated workpieces Small, fine and in excellent Baublies quality: these are the burnishing tools which we have developed for filigree applications. We have optimized our many years of know-how in diamond burnishing for the machining of small precision parts and thin-walled workpieces in a compact form. Diamond burnishing tools from the COLIBRI series are always optimally suitable when the peak-to-valley height of filigree workpieces is to be minimized and at the same time the strength is to be increased.               Single-Roller burnishing tool variable Extremely smooth surfaces in just seconds. Surface roughness of under Rz 1µm, short cycle times and low investments with fast amortization make chipless roller burnishing a high-quality, cost effective alternative to any cutting process. Variable single-roller burnishing tools are flexibly adjustable for various contours and can be used in hard-to-reach places. The rolling unit can be swiveled by 180°.
ADVANTAGES:
• adjustable angle for various contours
• suitable for work hardening tasks
• universally useable                 Diamond burnishing tools Diamond-burnishing tools expand the range of applications of roller burnishing technology, as even hardened materials up to approximately 60 HRC can be roller burnished. In the process, a high-precision, micropolished diamond glides over the surface. As soon as the yield point of the material is exceeded, the profile peaks of the workpiece surface flow into the adjacent recesses in the µm range. Compared to the machining by means of rollers, the contact area between the workpiece and the diamond is much smaller. Therefore, plastic cold working with a reduced influence of force can take place. Baublies diamond roller burnishing tools advance into hardness and diameter areas in which conventional roller burnishing tools cannot be used due to the workpiece characteristics or geometry.               Baublies forming tool for beading Forming in convincing quality: Forming tools from Baublies are used in a wide variety of applications including expanding, flanging and beading. Baublies forming tools are versatile, robust and durable. They enable the machining of small series on standard machines as well as the machining of large series on specialized machines. 

ADVANTAGES: 
• high process reliability 
• quick processing and short cycle times 
• high quality
